title: D3D12: Report device removal and implement GPU breadcrumbs via DRED

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/15661

## Additional information

<!--
Provide additional information and explanation of your PR, including areas that you are uncertain of or require special attention from reviewers. For examples, please read our pull request guidelines: https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/development/contribution_rules.html#explain-your-contributions

Points for reviewers:

- **No crash on detection.** Vulkan does `CRASH_NOW_MSG` after printing. This keeps D3D12's current behavior (functions return errors) so projects that handle device loss themselves keep working. Happy to crash instead if that's preferred for consistency,
- **Opt-in switch.** DRED rides on `--accurate-breadcrumbs`, which only exists in debug/dev builds.
- **Duplicated name table.** The breadcrumb-marker-to-string switch is copied from the Vulkan driver. It could move to a shared helper in `RenderingDeviceDriver` in a follow-up,
- Breadcrumbs are only inserted where `RenderingDeviceGraph` inserts them (draw list begin), as on Vulkan,
- The command line docs page in godot-docs says breadcrumbs are Vulkan-only.

Testing:
This patch helped me to find the root cause of the driver crash in my project. Attached example of a log. Happy to share more if needed.

### AI disclosure

The patch was written with an AI coding assistant.it read the Vulkan and D3D12 drivers, wrote the change, ported it to master, built and ran it. I reviewed the diff, decided the scope and the behavior questions above, and tested it on my machine.
